aqi._accepted_monitors_comment: AirNow monitors accepted as this node's regional reference. Readings from any other monitor are stored but marked out of area and never used for a value, a trend or a flag — see AQI/area.py. Chosen 2026-10-11 after PM2.5 came from Davis, ~45 mi east in the Sacramento Valley.

purpleair._comment: Valley-floor sensor selection. centerline runs down the valley floor; sensors within corridor_km of it are candidates, grouped into zones by position along it. Points are town centres, approximate — check on a map before trusting the selection. discovery_bbox is only the coarse pre-filter for the area search (nwlng, nwlat, selng, selat); the corridor does the real selection. The roster spreads sensors along the valley rather than taking the densest cluster: the line is cut into bin_km bins and at most max_per_bin sensors (nearest the floor) are kept per bin — two, so each spot has a cross-check.

fire.known_sources_comment: Fixed industrial heat sources, confirmed by satellite view on 2026-10-15. A detection within radius_m of one, at or below normal_max_frp_mw, is recorded as that source rather than counted by hotspot_within_20mi or high_confidence_within_50mi. Above that level it counts as normal. Observed history at confirmation: Potrero Hills 24 detections Jul 9 - Oct 14, max 0.72 MW; Novato 16 detections Jul 26 - Sep 20, max 0.98 MW. Farmland burning (Woodland, Oct 10 on) is deliberately not listed: it moves and is not fixed.
